page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top. Main column of litany lines, with curly braces at the right of the column each marked with "Ora pro nobis" text beside them; the middle brace label "Ora pro nobis" and the phrase "Omnes Sancti Apostoli & Evangelistæ, Ora-(te) pro nobis." sits in the text line. Catchword-like signature at the foot left and centre; a catchword "Omnes" at lower right.

main_text.l: Omnes Sancti Apostoli & Evangelistæ, Ora-(te) pro nobis.

page.notes: The braces at the right of the litany group the names with "Ora pro nobis" labels (first group after Sancte Bartholomæe, second after Sancte Vincenti); the label beside the Omnes line reads "Ora-(te) pro nobis". Faint show-through of the facing page is not transcribed. The bottom-left faint word is show-through and was omitted; "Omnes" at lower right is a catchword.
